_comment: Owner-editable map from the Copilot CLI's tool names (lower case, in the preToolUse hook's toolCalls[].name, the postToolUse hook's toolName and Archon's run log) to the Claude tool names the hooks and the audit gates read. Copilot CLI 1.0.114: bash, create, skill, view, grep (its folder in `paths`, one string) and glob were seen in real sessions; powershell, edit, task and web_fetch are the CLI's documented hook names; str_replace_editor, web_search and update_todo are only in its documented Claude mapping. Left unmapped on purpose: apply_patch (one patch can touch any file, so the scope guard denies it to a fenced agent rather than read it as an Edit), ask_user, and a tool with no Claude equivalent (fetch_copilot_cli_documentation): each keeps its runtime name. `node .archon/scripts/copilot-audit.js --names <run-id>` lists the names a run log really holds. Sources and the payload shape: .archon/copilot/baseline.md.
